KO_preservation: each A1,A2,A4,HW,LHW: if N>=100, retained_supported requires BOTH fight/event95% upper LL delta<=0.01 and upper Brier delta<=0.005; lower above either margin indicates not preserved; else uncertain. Thin cells descriptive. Compact aggregate success can coexist with a failed pathway; explicitly label tradeoff, never unqualified pathway success.
complete_system: same primary/secondary interval rules and annual rules, LL<0 and summed Brier upper<=0.004 both. Independent decision probabilities exactly identical. Report classwise calibration and clipping algebra. Conditional support does not assign composed support automatically.
current_specification_not_supported: pooled LL>0 with BOTH interval lower bounds>0, OR pooled Brier>0.002 with BOTH lower bounds>0.002; otherwise mixed criteria => INCONCLUSIVE
delta: candidate minus reference; lower LL/Brier favorable; ties abs<=1e-12
future: single fixed analysis; same criteria except annual gate replaced by four six-month cohort persistence described in forward protocol; no historical+forward pooling
inconclusive: any other valid result, including intervals crossing zero, metrics disagreeing, annual support failing; numerical/identity failure means INVALID_INCOMPLETE not scientific rejection
limitations: outer historical outcomes extensively inspected; architecture motivated by same evidence
bootstrap conditional on fixed models; event clusters do not remove repeat-fighter dependence or overlapping training
feature coefficients associations, not mechanism causality; probabilities not hazards/round transitions
pathway_status: B3 and B5 separately: supportive descriptive correction only if paired LL/Brier point deltas<0 AND abs(mean_K-actual_KO) smaller; require paired fight/event95% LL upper<0 and N>=100 to label supported_cell_improvement. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE or NOT_SUPPORTED when both losses worsen; panel overlap/inspection precludes independent confirmation.
priority: C-A primary; B-A isolation; C-B compact increment; preregistered separate statuses for conditional, pathways, composed and forward
secondary_multiplicity: B-A and C-B use97.5% intervals, Bonferroni family-wise5% for the two comparisons. Joint LL superiority and Brier noninferiority required; primary C-A95%. Diagnostic95% descriptive, no confirmatory group winner claims.

supported_improvement.annual: LL improves >=6 of9 years AND median annual delta<0 AND pooled LL delta after removing each single outer year<0
supported_improvement.brier: pooled delta<=0 and BOTH interval upper bounds<=0.002 absolute Brier units (noninferiority tolerance)
supported_improvement.calibration: report ECE, intercept/slope, gap even if discordant; never replace primary criteria with calibration/AUC
supported_improvement.log_loss: pooled delta<0 and BOTH paired fight/event interval upper bounds<0 at comparison-specific level
supported_improvement.scope: developmental historical support only; no production promotion
